data.narrative:
Sunflower Labs is a Series B stage drone and autonomous systems company that has raised $41.7M to date. The Drones & Autonomous sector comprises 8 private peers and 0 public comparables. Notable private peers include Elroy Air, Waymo, Wayve, Zipline, and Joby Aviation, though these vary significantly in stage and valuation tier.

Valuation triangulation relied on a single applicable method given data constraints. The Stage-Progression approach applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement to the $42M total raised proxy, yielding an implied valuation of $79M. A Peer-Median approach was not applicable: while 7 same-sector peers exist, filtering for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier comparables yielded insufficient datapoints (fewer than 3 required). Applying an all-sector median would introduce material bias given the heterogeneity of the peer set.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $67M to $91M, with a median point estimate of $79M. This range reflects ±15% around the stage-progression derived figure. Key uncertainties include the limited peer comparable universe in the Drones & Autonomous sector, the substantial variance in development stage and business model across identified peers, and the absence of public market anchors. Further diligence on unit economics, customer concentration, and technical differentiation would materially inform valuation tightening.
